messages:
maya: Quick QA — I opened a small terraform PR to rename the metrics adapter secret path and switch a couple of HPAs to use an external metric (prometheus/external) instead of legacy cpu-based mapping. Can someone eyeball for obvious gotchas? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4221 :eyes:

maya: Diff excerpt below (terraform):
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "prom_adapter" {
  metadata {
    name = "prom-adapter-metrics"
    annotations = { "redwood/metrics-path" = "/secrets/metrics/prom-adapter" }
  }
  data = { key = filebase64("secrets/prom-adapter.pem") }
}
# old path was /secret/prom-adapter (singular)
```

ow: does the HPA mapping need a follow-up patch or will the prometheus-adapter handle the path rename?

owen: quick read — the adapter only cares about the secret content, not the path in k8s if you update the deployment env var. But if you're also changing the metric name we need to update HPAs that reference the old external metric. Run `kubectl get hpa -A -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, metric: .spec.metrics}'` to see references.

leo: looked at the PR — the terraform plan shows the secret replaced (recreate). That's fine, but the prom-adapter Deployment env var `METRICS_SECRET_PATH` needs to be updated in the helm values or the adapter will fail to read at startup. I think the chart values are in `charts/observability/values.yaml`. Example HPA change we intend: 
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: inference-worker-hpa
spec:
  metrics:
  - type: External
    external:
      metric:
        name: redwood_prometheus_requests_per_second
        selector: { matchLabels: {job: "inference" } }
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "1000"
```

sanjay: +1 to checking the adapter env first. Also suggest we do a canary in `inference-pool-dev` before applying to prod. I can run the canary apply later today if you want. Also note that terraform will show `recreate` for the secret which can cause a short adapter restart — plan for a small rollout window.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan completed for branch `maya/hpa-metric-path` — 2 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy. Plan: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/plan/7890 (checks passed)

maya: Thanks — I'll update the helm values to point `METRICS_SECRET_PATH=/secrets/metrics/prom-adapter` and add a tiny preflight job that queries the adapter health endpoint before flipping the HPAs. Plan for canary in `inference-pool-dev` tomorrow 09:00 PT. Checklist: 1) helm values change, 2) terraform apply on infra (dev canary), 3) run script to PATCH any HPAs referencing `old_prom_metric_name` -> `redwood_prometheus_requests_per_second`.

sara: oncall — ping me 10m before canary and I'll watch SLOs. If anything spikes I can rollback.

owen: LGTM from me. One extra ask: add a short migration job (kubectl patch) in the PR description so ops can run it as part of rollout. Eg `kubectl patch hpa inference-worker -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/metrics/0/external/metric/name","value":"redwood_prometheus_requests_per_second"}]'`

maya: Will add the migration snippet to the PR and squash the helm change. Thanks all — will ping when canary starts. :thumbsup:
